evidence.curator_note: Top-left panel of Equation 8.82, arrow labelled 'r H' pointing down. The drawn molecular ion is R-CH(OH)-(CH2)n-C(=O)-OCH3 with the charge AND the odd electron printed as '+.' directly above the ester METHOXY oxygen (map 11) -- not above the carbonyl oxygen -- while the hydroxyl oxygen (map 9) is drawn neutral with its H. The product panel below shows that H sitting on the methoxy oxygen (drawn 'H-O(+)CH3') and a radical dot on the former hydroxyl oxygen (alkoxy radical), i.e. the hydroxyl H has migrated to the charge site through a large ring (with R = CH3, n = 5 the transition state counts 10 atoms; the p.197 text calls this 'such a larger-ring transition state (Equations 8.17, 8.82)' and attributes it to the high stability of the resulting neutral RCHO). Book draws 2 arc(s), BOTH single-barb fishhooks: (i) one starting on the hydroxyl O-H bond and sweeping right (the H leaving with one electron) and (ii) one starting at the '+.' odd electron on the methoxy oxygen and sweeping left toward that H (the odd electron pairing up with it). Both drawn arcs terminate on the migrating hydrogen, which cannot carry an atom map (RDKit folds a mapped explicit H into implicit valence), so they are encoded as the single heavy-atom-level move they produce: move <1> = the odd electron relocating from O(11) to O(9). Move <1> is therefore the encoded form of drawn arcs (i)+(ii); no implicit move is needed and the arrow gate reproduces both radical changes exactly. INSTANTIATION (the scheme is generic in R and in the chain length n): R = CH3 and n = 5, i.e. methyl 7-hydroxyoctanoate CH3-CH(OH)-(CH2)5-C(=O)-OCH3 (C9H18O3, M+. m/z 174.1250). n = 5 is the smallest chain that makes the final 'rH, a' step of this same scheme proceed through the favoured six-membered transition state, and it keeps the book's (CH2)n-3 label meaningful ((CH2)2). NO m/z and NO percentage is printed anywhere in Equation 8.82 except 'm/z 55' on the last product; every other mass in these records is the curator's computed monoisotopic value for this instantiation, not a measured number.

rule_index.json 'by_equation' has NO entry for 8.82 (the index stops at 8.14 for Chapter 8), so no MOD rule is cross-linked to this record. Nearest indexed families were checked against the DFS and REJECTED: hTransition_saturated_1 '[H]1[C]2[C]3[C]4[C]5[_A+.]6>>[C.]2[C]3[C]4[C]5[_A+]6[H]1' moves the H from a CARBON donor (explicit [C]2, leaving a carbon radical) across a fixed four-carbon bridge, whereas here the donor is an OXYGEN (an alkoxy radical is produced) and the bridge is the whole (CH2)n chain plus the ester group; esterMcLafferty_rH '[H]1[C]2[C]3[O]4[C]5({=}[O+.]6)[C]7>>...' likewise takes the H from a carbon and puts it on the CARBONYL oxygen, not on the alkoxy/methoxy oxygen that carries the '+.' here. So this reaction is currently unmodelled by the MOD rule set.
